title: List filtering preserves exactly matching members
summary: An element belongs to a filtered Lean list exactly when it belongs to the input and the Boolean predicate holds. Useful for membership and input-origin arguments.

source.statement: x ∈ List.filter p as ↔ x ∈ as ∧ p x

assumptions: p : α → Bool; as : List α; x : α, with Lean's List membership and Boolean-to-proposition coercion.
The statement concerns the pure Lean List.filter definition at the pinned revision.
limitations: Membership equivalence does not by itself specify order, multiplicity, execution time, or termination of an unrelated implementation.
No correspondence to JavaScript Array.filter or any caller's code has been established.
reuse: With leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0, import Init.Data.List.Lemmas and refer to List.mem_filter. Check the instantiated statement and any implementation correspondence yourself.
